diagnoses.label: ikea_negative_payment_total_selection
diagnoses.general_pattern: On receipts that print the final paid amount both at a 'Total (RM) Including GST' summary line and again at a card/tender line as a negative number (e.g., 'Visa -538.00' or 'Mastercard -99.80'), the extractor must pick the positive summary total line and must not let a negative payment token or an upstream 'TAX INVOICE' header mis-anchor the fallback.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: The run writes 702.00 for 074.jpg (IKEA) where the receipt clearly shows 'Total RM Including GST 6% 538.00' with a 'Visa -538.00' tender line; a non-total amount from elsewhere on the receipt (e.g., 702.00 produced by digit substitution/concatenation on a subtotal/tender fragment or a mis-selected candidate from a sibling receipt pattern) is selected instead of the printed 538.00 summary total. For 088.jpg (also IKEA, 99.80) the same shape is handled correctly, so the failure is pattern-contingent on this particular OCR variant of 074.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Prediction row 074.jpg total_amount='702.00' with feedback amount_correct=false; 088.jpg total_amount='99.80' amount_correct=true. Image 074 printed 'Total RM Including GST 6% 538.00' / 'Visa -538.00'. Trajectory shows multi-pass voting (ocr_variants, extract_total_with_tier) and debug on 064/074/077/078 as problematic cases; '702.00' does not appear on the receipt as any legitimate monetary token.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: The skill's receipt_total_keyword_priority_disambiguation and multi_variant_consensus_over_tier_priority anchors do not instruct the agent to (a) treat negative-signed tender lines ('Visa -X', 'Mastercard -X') as tender anchors that corroborate (rather than compete with) a same-magnitude 'Total RM Including GST' summary line, and (b) reject any candidate whose magnitude is not corroborated by at least one of {same-tier line, subtotal, |negative tender|} when such anchors are confidently present on the same variant.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: In the receipt overlay, extend the TOTAL RM tier to canonically match 'TOTAL RM INCLUDING GST', 'TOTAL (RM) INCLUDING GST', 'TOTAL ROUNDED', and 'TOTAL INCL(.) GST'. When a tender line matching VISA/MASTERCARD/CARD/CREDIT/DEBIT carries a signed amount, use its absolute value as a corroborating anchor in multi_variant_consensus_over_tier_priority: a candidate equal (within rounding) to |tender| should outrank an uncorroborated same-tier candidate from another variant. Never select a token that is not corroborated by any other total/subtotal/|tender| anchor across variants.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies to receipt-OCR tasks whose declared keyword list contains TOTAL/TOTAL RM/TOTAL AMOUNT and whose receipts commonly show a negative-signed tender line equal to the printed total; still scoped to the receipt overlay already present in image-ocr/SKILL.md.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Do not import |tender| corroboration into generic OCR, non-receipt forms, or xlsx formula-model totals; do not apply to receipts where the tender is split across multiple cards (sum must equal total, not any single tender).
diagnoses.target_section: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → multi_variant_consensus_over_tier_priority (and receipt_total_keyword_priority_disambiguation canonical keyword list)

diagnoses.label: myNEWS_grand_total_null_writeback_regression
diagnoses.general_pattern: When the receipt prints a clean 'GRAND TOTAL' line with the number on the same line (highest priority tier), the extractor must emit that value as a two-decimal string; a failed extraction must be written as a true null, not as an empty string that compares differently from None on readback.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: For 078.jpg the agent wrote total_amount='' (empty string) despite the receipt showing 'SUB TOTAL 10.00' / 'GRAND TOTAL 10.00' plainly on separate lines. The historical trajectory also shows a 92.80→100.00 oscillation on another receipt (THAI DELICIOUS, image 078 in a prior iteration was conflated via upscaled 'Grand Total' with no digits causing fallback to 'Change 7.20' or 'Cash Received 100.00'). The final writeback uses '' rather than Python None.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Prediction row 078.jpg total_amount='' feedback amount_correct=false; task_prompt declares 'If extraction fails for either field, the value is set to null'. Image 078 (myNEWS, Pagoh) prints 'GRAND TOTAL 10.00'. Image 074 trajectory thought: 'Grand Total line had no number! So my algorithm fell back to next line — Change 7.20 is excluded → break. No number → try next candidate.' Delivery scoring treats '' as not matching the expected null, so '' is a contract violation even where extraction legitimately fails.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: The skill tells the agent to use Python None on failure (null_vs_empty_string_contract) but does not reinforce that: (1) when a GRAND TOTAL line clearly has a trailing numeric token the two-decimal regex must be applied directly to that line before any fallback; (2) the writeback layer must guard against stringifying None to '' when round-tripping through pandas/openpyxl, and the xlsx delivery self-check must assert cell.value is None rather than cell.value == ''.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Strengthen the receipt overlay so the GRAND TOTAL tier (priority 1) always re-runs the monetary two-decimal regex on the keyword line itself before the guarded split-line fallback, including on degraded variants (e.g., 'GRAND TOTAL 10.00' with inner whitespace). In the xlsx writeback companion, require the delivery self-check to specifically test for None (not '') and to fail-loud if any cell declared nullable contains ''.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies to receipt-extraction tasks whose contract declares null for failed extractions; targets both the extraction null-return and the xlsx writeback self-check.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Do not apply to tasks whose contract uses '' or a specific placeholder; do not treat legitimate '0.00' values as nulls.
diagnoses.target_section: image-ocr: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → null_vs_empty_string_contract, Quality Self-Check; xlsx: Preserving null vs empty string on writeback, Delivery contract verification for data-only xlsx outputs

diagnoses.label: shell_petrodeli_summary_total_vs_tender_disambiguation
diagnoses.general_pattern: On Shell/petrol receipts, 'Total', 'Total Gross', 'Visa', and the fuel-amount line all share the same numeric magnitude. The extractor must prefer the labeled summary 'Total' (or 'Total Gross') line and must not drift to a tender/row-adjacent value whose OCR has a leading-digit substitution (e.g., 85.54 ↔ 85.84, 86.00 ↔ 86.17).
diagnoses.wrong_approach: 077.jpg (Shell Petrodeli, 85.54) is written as 23.26 in an earlier iteration and 23.25 in the final — both wrong; the final write 23.26 reflects a candidate pulled from a different receipt pattern or from an unrelated 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' line that OCR confused with the Shell receipt's own layout. For 063.jpg (Shell Petrodeli-like, 85.54) the correct value is emitted, so the issue is variant-specific OCR noise plus tier selection, not the keyword list itself.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Prediction 077.jpg total_amount='23.26' amount_correct=false; image 077 printed 'Total RM 85.54 / Visa RM 85.54 / Total Gross C RM 85.54'. Trajectory thought on 064 shows the voting mechanism pulling 688.17 from a non-total line via the TOTAL RM tier because 'Total RM = B81?' failed numeric parse and the fallback used an adjacent 'Visa RM =688.17'. The same class of failure plausibly misroutes 077 to an unrelated '23.26' candidate from a different image under batch voting.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: ocr_amount_normalization_and_arithmetic_crosscheck is defined but is not wired to petrol-receipt layout where subtotal/tax are not both present; multi_variant_consensus_over_tier_priority also lacks an explicit rule that cross-variant support must be computed per-image, never pooled across images in a batch. Additionally the guarded split-line fallback should refuse to walk from a 'Total RM' line to a 'Visa RM' line even when the former has zero digits, because VISA is a tender keyword.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Tighten the guarded split-line fallback: the fallback line must not match any payment/tender keyword (VISA, MASTERCARD, CASH, CARD, CREDIT, DEBIT, TENDER, PAYMENT) even when the keyword line has zero digits; instead back off to an earlier same-tier candidate or try the next tier. Make per-image state isolation explicit in multi_variant_consensus_over_tier_priority so that batch processing cannot leak a candidate value across images.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Receipt overlay only; applies to petrol/retail receipts where tender lines (VISA/MASTERCARD) print the same magnitude as the total.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Do not add VISA/MASTERCARD to the generic exclusion list that governs tier matching (the keyword 'TOTAL' can legitimately appear on a 'Total Gross' line); the restriction is only on the split-line fallback destination.
diagnoses.target_section: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → receipt_total_keyword_priority_disambiguation step 4 (guarded split-line fallback) and multi_variant_consensus_over_tier_priority

diagnoses.label: receipt_date_locale_batch_inference_regression_on_034
diagnoses.general_pattern: In Malaysian receipt batches the dominant day/month ordering is DD/MM/YYYY. The locale/label-bound date resolver must bind the date to a 'Date' label line and must not swap day/month when both components are ≤12 unless an unambiguous row in the batch forces the alternate ordering.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: 034.jpg date is written as 2018-08-09; the receipt shows 'Date: 09/03/2018' (Perniagaan Zheng Hui, Malaysian layout). The agent appears to have interpreted the date under MM/DD/YYYY (03→09 month/day swap) despite dominant batch evidence (e.g., 23/01/2019, 18/01/2018, 15/06/2017, 29/12/2017, 20/02/18, 18/03/18, 21/02/18, 26/02/18, 27/07/17, 09/08/17, 30/05/2017, 29-10-2017, 02/02/2017, 20/03/2018, 23/03/2018, 30/03/2018, 13/03/2017) — many of which have day>12 and anchor DD/MM/YYYY.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: Prediction 034.jpg date='2018-08-09' feedback date_correct=false; all other 21 dates are date_correct=true, consistent with DD/MM/YYYY parsing (e.g., 2019-01-23 for 007 which reads '23-01-2019'). The anomalous 034 result is consistent with the parser silently falling back to MM/DD/YYYY on this one row.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: receipt_date_label_binding_and_locale states the batch-majority inference rule but does not force the parser to apply the inferred locale uniformly to every row once at least one unambiguous DD>12 row exists in the batch. The parser also lacks a tie-break instruction that, under declared Malaysian locale (DD/MM/YYYY), DD/MM is the default even for all-≤12 tokens.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Make the locale inference a hard precondition: compute the dominant ordering once from unambiguous rows in the batch, then apply it to every ambiguous row. When the task prompt or receipts clearly declare a locale (Malaysian GST/SST receipts), DD/MM/YYYY must be the default even in the absence of any DD>12 anchor; MM/DD may only override when an unambiguous MM>12 row forces it.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Receipt overlay only; applies to date fields extracted from receipts with declared or inferable Malaysian/DD-first locale.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Do not force DD/MM/YYYY on US-locale receipts, ISO-dated receipts, or non-receipt documents; do not override an unambiguous MM>12 row.
diagnoses.target_section: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → receipt_date_label_binding_and_locale

diagnoses.label: iteration_budget_consumed_by_per_image_debug_loop
diagnoses.general_pattern: For N-image batch OCR with per-image heuristic failures, interactive per-image terminal debug loops exhaust the agent's iteration budget before the heuristic set converges, leaving late-identified regressions unpatched at termination.
diagnoses.wrong_approach: The source run terminated via termination_reason='max_iterations' at 65 iterations (acp_stop_reason='max_turn_requests') with response_tool_call_counts terminal=27, think=22, file_editor=16, and the final write still contained three uncorrected amount errors (074, 077, 078) and one uncorrected date error (034). The windowed exchanges show the agent repeatedly re-running single-image OCR with print(repr(line)) and thinking through each case rather than planning a consolidated edit.
diagnoses.observable_evidence: execution_metadata.termination_reason='max_iterations', agent_iterations=65, max_iterations_at_source=65, iteration_limit_hits=1; late exchanges (e0041-e0046) show per-image debug on 064/074/077/078/078 with no corresponding workbook rewrite before termination. Final predictions still have the three amount regressions and the 034 date flip.
diagnoses.missing_reasoning_step: The skill's workflow note 'batch-diagnostic-then-batch-edit' exists but is not prescriptive enough: it does not require (a) a single dump pass that emits per-image (variant, candidate_tier, candidate_value, chosen_value) rows for all N images into one artifact, (b) a planning step that proposes one consolidated set of pattern/variant edits covering multiple failures, and (c) a single re-run and writeback. It also does not warn that interactive per-image iteration will deplete the budget.
diagnoses.correct_general_approach: Strengthen the workflow note into a required procedure: for batch OCR tasks of size ≥10, after the first prediction pass, emit a single diagnostic CSV/JSON with one row per image (OCR slice around keywords, candidate list, current prediction, confidence) and then propose at most one consolidated edit set per outer loop. Explicitly cap per-image interactive debug (e.g., budget-fraction heuristic) and prefer re-running the full pipeline over per-image edits.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Applies to batch OCR / batch structured-extraction tasks only; not to single-image or small-N interactive flows.
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Do not forbid interactive debugging on single-document tasks or on tasks whose verifier reports per-row errors with high-confidence oracle labels.
diagnoses.target_section: Structured Field Extraction from Receipts → Workflow note: batch-diagnostic-then-batch-edit

overlay.composition_issue: The current receipt overlay in image-ocr/SKILL.md already encodes tier-priority disambiguation, two-decimal invariants, guarded split-line fallback, locale-bound dates, and the null-vs-empty-string contract. The observed failures (074 702.00, 077 23.26, 078 '', 034 date flip, and termination at max_iterations) sit at seams between anchors: (a) multi_variant_consensus_over_tier_priority does not treat negative-signed tender lines (Visa/Mastercard -X) as corroboration for an equal-magnitude summary total, nor require per-image state isolation under batch voting; (b) receipt_total_keyword_priority_disambiguation step 4 does not forbid the guarded split-line fallback from walking to a tender/payment line when the keyword line's digits failed OCR parse; (c) receipt_date_label_binding_and_locale leaves the DD/MM default implicit when all date components are ≤12 in a declared Malaysian batch; (d) null_vs_empty_string_contract is not strongly cross-linked to the xlsx delivery self-check so '' leaks into failed-extraction cells; (e) the batch-diagnostic-then-batch-edit workflow note is advisory rather than prescriptive and did not prevent the per-image debug loop that consumed the iteration budget. The editor should strengthen these existing anchors rather than add new skills or rewrite the generic OCR flow.
preservation_constraints: Do not alter the generic OCR flow, JSON output schema, PSM/preprocessing guidance, or guidance for non-receipt documents in image-ocr/SKILL.md.

Do not import receipt-specific tokens (RM, VISA, MASTERCARD, GRAND TOTAL, DD/MM/YYYY) into openai-vision, pdf, video-frame-extraction, or into xlsx guidance that is unrelated to data-only receipt extraction.
Preserve the explicit scope language (receipt-style OCR tasks that declare their own keyword/exclusion/null conventions) on every strengthened anchor.
Do not hard-code the current task's keyword tiers, exclusion list, locale, or specific example values from any receipt in the source run.
Preserve the xlsx 'Preserving null vs empty string on writeback' scope note that this rule only applies when the task contract explicitly distinguishes null from empty string.
Keep the batch-diagnostic-then-batch-edit note scoped to batch OCR / batch structured-extraction tasks; do not forbid interactive debugging in general.

package_assessment.rationale: All four observable field-level failures (074 amount, 077 amount, 078 amount, 034 date) and the iteration-budget termination map cleanly to seams in anchors that already exist in the candidate image-ocr receipt overlay and the xlsx null-vs-empty writeback note. The infrastructure (Tesseract/pytesseract/Pillow/openpyxl) is pre-installed per the task prompt and worked (predictions were delivered as a valid xlsx with 22 rows; 20/22 cells correct). The source agent did not use vision tools and had no model-side limitation blocking the correct heuristics; the regressions are heuristic-selection and writeback-contract failures, not executor/infra failures. Therefore the package is skill-controllable and the correct response is to strengthen existing anchors (multi_variant_consensus_over_tier_priority, receipt_total_keyword_priority_disambiguation step 4, receipt_date_label_binding_and_locale, null_vs_empty_string_contract, batch-diagnostic-then-batch-edit) rather than add new skills.
